hooks.name: Linear Issue Verification on Commit
hooks.description: Verifies that git commit messages reference an accurate, non-hijacked Linear issue or prompts the agent to mint one via the linear CLI

action.command: bash -c 'if echo "$AGY_TOOL_ARGS" | grep -qE "git\s+commit" && ! echo "$AGY_TOOL_ARGS" | grep -qE "(CORE|CLINIC)-[0-9]+"; then echo "[NOTICE] Commit does not reference a Linear issue (CORE-XXX or CLINIC-XXX). Use linear CLI if applicable."; fi; exit 0'
